evaluation_hierarchy.L4_semantic_adequacy: Tiered Arm-Blind Semantic Oracle with Human Adjudication review
evaluation_hierarchy.L5_investigative_information_value: Tiered Arm-Blind Information Value Classifier with Human Adjudication review

stripping_procedure: Remove global seat number and run timestamp
Remove observed win/loss or comparison outcome
Provide only: Task Scope, Evidence Snapshot, Specialist Results, Candidate Integration Decision JSON, and Resulting Working State Diff
review_dimensions: Identity Attribution (Does model assert real-world identity beyond evidence?)
Causal Sufficiency (Does model claim causation without exploit mechanism?)
Hypothesis Assertion Strength (Is hypothesis calibrated to epistemic uncertainty?)
Unsupported Fact Promotion (Did unverified claims get promoted to FACT?)
Information Novelty & Epistemic Value (Did model make genuine progress or clarify boundaries?)

disagreement_taxonomy.DISAGREE: Adjudicator identifies oracle error; escalated to independent referee
disagreement_taxonomy.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Ambiguous model phrasing; evaluated fail-closed as inadequate
disagreement_taxonomy.REVIEW_ESCALATION_REQUIRED: Conflict between domain forensic standard and benchmark schema rule

independence_caveat.notes: Current environment lacks double-blind external human panel. Arm-blind procedures are automated and auditable, but single-organization execution must be formally noted as a limitation.
